runners_data.name: Tarlac
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but 7lb claimer Jake Dickson may struggle in tactical battle with experienced riders

runners_data.name: Beerwah
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with excellent recent form including course win, headgear back on suggests connections expect improvement

runners_data.name: Kyber Crystal
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good form with top jockey booking and useful weight, recent course third is strong form line

runners_data.name: Wee Mary
runners_data.note: Hold-up type carrying only 8st 9lbs with hat back on, trainer's 3/26 strike rate provides optimism

runners_data.name: Until Dawn
runners_data.note: Sole leader should get uncontested advantage, hat first time suggests stepping up after disappointing efforts

runners_data.name: Sixcor
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner whose 8st 7lbs minimum weight and 3lb claimer gives significant weight advantage

runners_data.name: Ski Angel
runners_data.note: Prominent type with decent recent form but trainer's 0/13 record over past fortnight is concerning

runners_data.name: Classy Clarets
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid recent form but faces difficult task from rear in pace-favouring contest

races.paceDynamic: Until Dawn will lead unchallenged early as the sole front-runner, setting a sustainable tempo on good ground over this sharp 5f. Behind him, Thornaby Pearl, Tarlac, Kyber Crystal, Sixcor and Ski Angel will create a wall of prominent runners, likely bunching into traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up quartet of Thunderstorm Katie, Beerwah, Wee Mary and Classy Clarets will need significant luck in running from the back. This race shape strongly favours the leader and early prominent runners who can secure clear racing room before the inevitable squeeze.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn gets an easy lead and kicks clear 2f out
scenarios.body: The uncontested front-runner builds an unassailable advantage while the prominent pack gets tangled up behind. His recent third at this trip suggests stamina to see out the 5f when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners create a wall turning for home
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable as prominent runners interfere with each other, allowing a hold-up horse with clear water to swoop late. Beerwah's recent winning form makes him the prime beneficiary.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Speed Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Thornaby Pearl or Kyber Crystal press Until Dawn from the start
scenarios.body: The increased early gallop sets up a collapse scenario where stamina becomes crucial over this minimum trip. Late runners with the best finishing kicks benefit from the strong pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sixcor Sneaks Through
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran finds racing room on the rails while others get blocked
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old uses his experience to thread between horses as the prominent pack bunches, picking up the pieces late. His low weight and Tom Kiely-Marshall's 3lb claim provide additional advantages.

watchPoints.text: Watch for scrimmaging between Thornaby Pearl, Kyber Crystal, Sixcor and Ski Angel in the prominent positions 2f out
Monitor if Beerwah and Thunderstorm Katie get clear racing room turning for home as the main hold-up threats
Check if Until Dawn gets pressured early by any of the prominent runners breaking their usual tactical approach
Observe whether the headgear changes on Beerwah, Wee Mary and Until Dawn produce immediate positive responses
Track if the three claiming jockeys maintain their intended positions or get outmuscled tactically by senior riders

races.name: British EBF Supporting Racing Welfare #mentalhealthawarenessweek Restricted Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')
Prime Secure William Wallace Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Harriet Quimby
runners_data.note: Front runner with class edge and Oisin Orr booking, but 34-day layoff longer than rivals after last win

runners_data.name: My Ballyquinn
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse facing tactical disadvantage in small field, though David O'Meara 13-day freshening could help

runners_data.name: Gaelic Approach
runners_data.note: Natural leader who must battle Harriet Quimby early, but lowest weight and Connor Beasley's 5lb claim provides compensation

races.paceDynamic: Harriet Quimby and Gaelic Approach will clash early as both confirmed front runners, creating an honest gallop from the off. With only three runners, the pace will be genuine but not suicidal, as My Ballyquinn sits back as the lone hold-up horse. The sustained nature of 1m3f at Hamilton means the early leaders must respect the trip while maintaining position. This race shape strongly favours the prominent/front running horses who can control the tempo, as My Ballyquinn faces a difficult task giving weight and making up ground on just two rivals.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Harriet Quimby and Gaelic Approach settle into a sustainable rhythm after initial skirmishing
scenarios.body: The honest pace suits both leaders who can kick for home in tandem, leaving My Ballyquinn with too much ground to make up. Superior fitness and class ratings of the front pair prove decisive in a small field where tactical positioning is crucial.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders respect each other too much and crawl through the early stages
scenarios.body: The lack of pace allows My Ballyquinn to stay closer than usual and unleash a telling late surge. David Nolan can time his run perfectly in a sprint finish where the front runners have little left in reserve.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Speed Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Harriet Quimby and Gaelic Approach engage in a genuine speed battle from the start
scenarios.body: Both leaders go too fast early on the testing Hamilton circuit, setting it up perfectly for My Ballyquinn's hold-up style. The 13-day break gives My Ballyquinn the freshness edge over rivals returning from longer layoffs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Harriet Quimby Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the recent winner can dominate from flag-fall and dictate terms completely
scenarios.body: Oisin Orr uses the class edge and superior RPR to control the race from the front, grinding down Gaelic Approach in the straight. My Ballyquinn never gets close enough to challenge in a race run to suit the highest-rated performer.

watchPoints.text: My Ballyquinn needs to be closer than usual early or faces impossible task against just two front runners
Harriet Quimby's 34-day break could show as the pace intensifies despite superior class ratings
Gaelic Approach's 5lb weight advantage through Connor Beasley's claim could prove decisive if pace becomes searching
Small field dynamics mean any horse that gets isolated will struggle to recover position
David Nolan's tactical awareness crucial for My Ballyquinn to time run perfectly in likely sprint finish

runners_data.note: Only prominent runner returning from long break, key tactical role in how the race unfolds

runners_data.name: Antrim
runners_data.note: Sole front runner with winning form at the trip, 42 days since last run may have him primed

runners_data.name: Tiernan

races.paceDynamic: Antrim is the sole confirmed front runner and should dictate terms from the outset, likely getting an uncontested lead given the field composition. With Ouro Preto the only prominent runner, there's minimal early pressure expected, allowing Antrim to set a measured gallop through the early stages. The majority hold-up horses (Humble Spark, Majestic, Urban Road, Tiernan, Elsass) will be tracking in behind, creating a bunched field turning for home. This sustainable pace setup strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can unleash their finishing kicks against a potentially vulnerable lone leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Antrim sets an uncontested lead and the pace remains steady
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing speed in the final two furlongs. Urban Road and Elsass look best positioned with recent good form and lighter weights.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Antrim Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Antrim kicks clear turning for home and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The lone leader capitalizes on the tactical advantage and sustainable gallop to hold off late challengers. Burke's 4-year-old has winning form at this trip and could prove hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ouro Preto Prominent Play
scenarios.trigger: If Ouro Preto takes closer order and puts pressure on Antrim earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The prominent runner forces a stronger pace that suits his style while compromising the hold-up horses' kicks. His fresh return after 223 days could provide the edge needed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Antrim goes too slow and multiple horses make their moves simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best weighted horses with recent form prevail. This chaotic finish could suit any horse getting the right run.

watchPoints.text: Antrim's early fractions will determine everything - if he goes too slow early, he becomes very vulnerable
Urban Road's positioning turning for home is crucial given his strong recent form and light weight advantage
Ouro Preto's return from 223 days off makes him unpredictable but potentially dangerous if sharp
The hold-up horses bunching together in the straight could lead to traffic problems and hard luck stories
Weather conditions remaining good throughout the card will suit most runners' style preferences

races.paceDynamic: Salam Dubawi is the only confirmed front runner with Qitaal and Draupnir as prominent racers, creating a modest early pace that won't be overly testing. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Obito, Flying Fletcher, Austrian Theory, Sanafi Zabeel, Quiet Resolve, Naturalia, Tee Aitch Aye) will be tracking behind waiting to pounce. With limited early pace and a long home straight at Hamilton, this sets up perfectly for the patient brigade to unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on the modest gallop and time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady as expected
scenarios.body: The patient runners get the perfect setup to unleash late runs, with Austrian Theory and Obito best placed to exploit their superior ratings. The lack of early pressure allows closers to position ideally and strike when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If Qitaal and Draupnir press Salam Dubawi harder than anticipated
scenarios.body: A stronger early gallop stretches the field and makes it harder for the hold-up brigade to reel in the leaders. Draupnir's recent Redcar win suggests he can capitalize on tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Salam Dubawi Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: With minimal early pressure, Salam Dubawi could steal a march turning for home before the closers can react. His prominent style perfectly suits getting first run on patient rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all runners sit too far off Salam Dubawi early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with runners queuing up behind a crawling pace. The best-weighted horses with the strongest finishing kicks gain the biggest advantage.

watchPoints.text: Salam Dubawi could steal this if given too much rope early - watch if he gets uncontested lead
Obito returning after 192 days layoff - watch for fitness and whether he travels kindly in rear
Austrian Theory has strong RPR but unproven on good going - watch his action and comfort level
Quiet Resolve with inexperienced 5lb claimer in tactical race - watch positioning and jockey decisions
Draupnir wearing headgear for first time - watch for improved focus and behavior

races.paceDynamic: Picture Palace will lead unchallenged early as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting a manageable gallop over this extended 1m4f trip. Behind him, four prominent racers (Welbury, Unchartedterritory, Parole Officer, Born A Star) will create serious congestion tracking the leader, with traffic problems inevitable when they fan out 2-3 furlongs from home. The hold-up brigade (Delinquent, Horu Kanu, Angela's Baar, Saxophonist, Deep Sleep) will have clear running room in the back half as the field stretches out. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can exploit the positioning battle ahead of them and finish strongly into a solid gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets tangled up turning for home as predicted
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get first run on the outside while the prominent group sorts itself out, with the steady gallop perfect for late closers. Delinquent and Saxophonist can unleash their finishing kicks over runners caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Welbury Escapes Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If Welbury can secure the perfect trip tracking Picture Palace without getting boxed
scenarios.body: His superior recent form (12-35) and Rodriguez's tactical skills allow him to kick clear before the hold-up horses arrive. Born A Star could profit from similar prominent positioning if finding gaps.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Picture Palace Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and no serious challenge materializes
scenarios.body: The leader's sustainable gallop becomes unassailable as the field arrives too late, with his proven stamina over this trip decisive. Welbury provides the main danger if getting a clean run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Picture Palace goes too slow and gets swamped by the entire field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with the strongest finisher prevailing, likely from the hold-up ranks. Any horse with a turn of foot benefits from the sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Picture Palace setting genuine fractions early - if he goes too steady he becomes a sitting duck for the closers
Traffic congestion 2-3 furlongs out when Welbury, Unchartedterritory, Parole Officer and Born A Star all need racing room simultaneously
Delinquent getting cover in midfield - Sam James needs to avoid being caught wide tracking the early pace
Angela's Baar's fitness after 81 days off, any market support suggests connections confident despite layoff
David O'Meara's double-handed attack with Saxophonist and Unchartedterritory representing different tactical approaches

races.paceDynamic: Pallas Lord is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms unchallenged from the gate. With Nakatomi, Hashtagnotions and Uncle Liam providing some prominent company, the early pace will be steady rather than fierce. The lack of genuine pace pressure means Pallas Lord can bowl along comfortably, setting up a tactical affair where the real action comes late. This controlled tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks, as the leaders will have plenty left to find when the closers pounce.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late
scenarios.trigger: If Pallas Lord sets uncontested fractions and the prominent runners fail to apply meaningful pressure
scenarios.body: The steady pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and time their runs perfectly in the final two furlongs. Late runners with finishing pace will sweep past tiring leaders who've had to do all the donkey work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Nakatomi or Uncle Liam press Pallas Lord earlier than expected, creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favors horses that can travel strongly in behind the pace without being too far back. Mid-race positioning becomes crucial as the early burn-up exposes pure closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pallas Lord Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains crawling and no horse can produce a significant turn of foot
scenarios.body: The leader's class advantage tells as he's never put under serious pressure and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges. Patient tactics backfire when there's insufficient pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so pedestrian that the entire field bunches up entering the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where luck in running and positioning matters more than pure ability. The first horse to find daylight and quicken could steal it regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Uncle Liam's recent consistency and prominent style could prove decisive if he can get first run on the leaders
Pallas Lord's 59-day absence may tell in the final furlong if pressed harder than his recent work suggests he's ready for
Nakatomi's significant class drop with claiming allowance makes him dangerous if the pace develops as expected
Perfidia's 7lb claimer may struggle with tactical decision-making in what looks likely to become a messy finish
Hashtagnotions showed improved form last time and Oisin Orr's presence suggests connections expect another step forward
